scope: Portfolio readiness audit and remediation; single-instance demo
fixes: Profile header is a direct prefetched link, avoiding the intermediate /user redirect.
Profile content renders after its primary request; independent activity, playlists, artists and friends load in parallel.
Artist header renders before descendant requests complete; obsolete artist requests are aborted.
Profile and playlist route instances isolate late requests and mutations; obsolete chat-opening responses cannot redirect a new profile.
Player album and performer links are available in the persistent bar and expanded view; row performer links are separate from playback buttons.
Feed listening cards have an explicit Play/Pause control and relative timestamps backed by one shared clock.
Public browsing loads additional catalogue pages; admin editors read the complete bounded metadata index with deduplication and session ownership checks.
Song editors support singles, distinguish explicit album clearing from omission, and preserve unchanged guest credits.
Registration retries sign-in after successful or pending account creation without repeating registration.
Keyboard users can focus the album cover file input.
Chat reserves the player height measured by ResizeObserver, replacing an overlapping fixed mobile offset.

localBrowser.method: Updated production build, existing synthetic accounts, proxied authenticated reads; in-memory audio fixture; realtime transport is deliberately not connected in this local check.

livePlaybackBeforeRelease.method: Actual headless Edge playback with no media interception; elapsed time includes polling and is not a percentile performance benchmark.

dataPreservation: Live demo seed is additive and journaled, uses only existing catalogue records, and has private pre-write database backups. Recording and validation use synthetic accounts. Downloader code, credentials and downloaded media are excluded from repository changes.
limits: Source review covers all listed product areas; this is not an exhaustive device, accessibility, concurrency or load certification.
Production email recovery remains unavailable until an email relay is configured, as requested.
Three catalogue artists retain honest initial-based fallbacks where verified artwork was unavailable.
Large-scale caching, multi-replica coordination and backend rewrites were not introduced without a confirmed defect.
